message:
You know those moments when you think, "I really should be prepared for a blackout"? Well, let me tell you, having a plan in place can turn that nagging thought into a smug 'I told you so' moment when the lights go out. 

I recently came across some great tips from the Red Cross about how to get ready for power outages. It's all about keeping your family safe and comfy when the unexpected happens, and trust me, it feels good to be ready! 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during a blackout? I'd love to hear your tricks! 🌟
